about: The masters of the wiki's paintings (WebP, quality 90) and where each came from. Recraft painted the scenes (painted/<slug>.webp, as upscaled); tools/make-wiki-screens.py lays the app's own screens into their phones (screens.json says which, from the app's render-test goldens and demo-drive frames) and writes <slug>.webp, so every dial, number and readout on a phone is the app's (George, 24 Oct 2026: the painted dials were garbled). tools/make-wiki-art.py makes the served sizes from <slug>.webp. Licence: every image was made on VGraphics' Recraft Pro plan (a paid plan, so the images are ours to use commercially); the Worlds outpaint used Nano Banana 2.1 through the same Recraft Pro plan.
